purpose: WI-5 second-issuer evidence. Every quote below is recorded for what it establishes and for what it does not establish. After review, no wording in this filing declares preference share capital nil; the notes recorded here exist to show the question was asked, answered in the negative, and left as NOT_REPORTED.

conclusion.decision: No qualifying explicit nil disclosure exists for PREFERENCE_CAPITAL in the audited consolidated statements. The only share-class sentence is scoped by its own heading to equity shares and speaks about classes of equity shares; the balance sheet, the statement of changes in equity and Notes 13, 14, 41, 46 and 47 present no preference-share component. Presentation completeness is not a declaration, so the governed observation is MISSING / NOT_REPORTED and no zero is substituted.
conclusion.withdrawnClaim: The WI-5 bundle as first committed declared PREFERENCE_CAPITAL nil on Q1's wording (payloadDigest 287622ae69fbe39bc2cfb7804983877042a32fbfbf7ffbbad3b711aaf9b00eb3). That declaration was withdrawn on 2026-11-07; the superseded payload is kept under artifact/superseded/ so the retraction is auditable.

quotes.note: Note 13 Share capital — sub-heading 'Terms / rights attached to equity shares'
quotes.sourceLocator: Annual Report 2023-24 -> Consolidated Financial Statements -> Notes forming part of the consolidated financial statements -> Note 13 Share capital -> heading 'Terms / rights attached to equity shares' -> first sentence
quotes.heading: Terms / rights attached to equity shares
quotes.exactWording: The Company has only one class of equity shares having a par value of Rs 10 per share.
quotes.surroundingContext: The Company has only one class of equity shares having a par value of Rs 10 per share. Each holder of equity shares is entitled to one vote per equity share. The Company declares and pays dividends in Indian rupees.
quotes.establishes: that the Company's equity shares are a single class with a par value of Rs 10, carrying one vote per share and rupee dividends — the Schedule III 'terms/rights attached to equity shares' disclosure
quotes.doesNotEstablish: the absence of preference share capital. The sentence is scoped by its own heading to equity shares and speaks about classes of equity shares; it says nothing about any other class of shares, and no preference-share caption, balance or sentence appears in the filing (see source/preference-capital-investigation.txt). It therefore cannot carry a nil declaration, however it is read, and was the sole support for the withdrawn nil.
quotes.whyItWasWithdrawn: Read against the Infosys sentence WI-3 accepted ('the Company has only one class of shares referred to as equity shares'), this wording is narrower: Infosys says one class of *shares* and names it; eClerx says one class of *equity shares*. The narrower sentence does not exclude a preference class, and a nil may not be inferred from what a sentence leaves out.

quotes.note: Note 13 Share capital — authorised and issued capital captions
quotes.sourceLocator: Note 13 -> 'Authorised share capital (Rupees in Million)' table
quotes.exactWording: Authorised share capital 100,000,000 (March 31, 2023: 100,000,000) shares of Rs. 10 each 1,000.00 1,000.00 Issued, subscribed and fully paid up 48,232,242 (March 31, 2023: 48,033,979) shares of Rs. 10 each fully paid up 482.32 480.34
quotes.establishes: a single authorised-capital caption of 100,000,000 shares of Rs 10 each (Rs 1,000.00 million) and issued capital of 48,232,242 shares (Rs 482.32 million)
quotes.doesNotEstablish: a stated preference position: the caption is not labelled 'equity' or 'preference' and carries no nil wording. A one-line authorised capital is consistent with the absence of a preference class, but consistency is not a declaration.

quotes.sourceLocator: Consolidated Balance Sheet as at March 31, 2024 -> Equity
quotes.exactWording: Equity share capital 13 482.32 480.34 Other equity 14 21,992.69 16,668.37 Total equity attributable to shareholders of the Company 22,475.01 17,148.71 Non-controlling interests 19.69 16.83 Total equity 22,494.70 17,165.54
quotes.establishes: that the whole of consolidated equity at both dates is decomposed into equity share capital, other equity and non-controlling interests, and the components sum to the reported totals to the paisa
quotes.doesNotEstablish: a nil by disclosure: an equity section that presents no preference line is presentation, not a declaration, and this bundle does not convert completeness arithmetic into a nil. It is recorded so a later reviewer can see the strongest available corroboration and why it was still not enough for D-2.

quotes.sourceLocator: Statement of Changes in Equity -> a. Equity share capital (opening 4,80,33,979 shares / 480.34 to closing 4,82,32,242 shares / 482.32)
quotes.exactWording: a. Equity share capital ... As at March 31, 2024 4,82,32,242 482.32
quotes.establishes: that the only share-capital column in the statement of changes in equity is equity shares
quotes.doesNotEstablish: a declaration about preference shares; the absence of a column is presentation

quotes.exactWording: For the purpose of the Group's capital management, capital includes issued equity capital, share premium and all other equity reserves attributable to the equity holders of the parent.
quotes.establishes: the composition of what the Group calls capital for gearing purposes
quotes.doesNotEstablish: a nil declaration: the sentence defines capital for a ratio, and 'includes' is not 'consists only of'. Contrast Infosys, where the capital-management note states 'the Company has only one class of equity shares and has no debt' — an affirmative sentence eClerx does not have.

quotes.sourceLocator: Note 46 -> Debt-Equity ratio row -> denominator/numerator description
quotes.exactWording: Debt-Equity ratio Total debt (represents lease liabilities and working capital loan) Shareholder's equity 0.12 0.11 0.00%
quotes.establishes: that the Group's own debt definition for its disclosed ratio is lease liabilities plus working capital loan
quotes.doesNotEstablish: a preference-capital nil; it is a ratio definition and says nothing about share classes
